about: Saugeen Shores is a town on Lake Huron in Bruce County, Ontario, combining Port Elgin, Southampton, and surrounding rural land. Long freshwater beaches, a harbour, and the Chantry Island lighthouse offshore define a classic Huron shore community. Highway 21 follows the coast through town. About 16,000 people live in Saugeen Shores.
